responsibility: Defines rustc’s THIR data model for `rustc_middle`: the typed body container, index types, and the expression, statement, block, pattern, parameter, and related node structures used after HIR lowering and before MIR construction. It also includes THIR-specific semantic helpers such as pattern-range comparison and embeds the visitor submodule, making this file the central definition of the simplified, type-checked high-level IR consumed by later analyses and MIR lowering.
